segments.he: גַּם אָנֹכִי פּוֹרֵס בִשְׁלוֹם יְדִידִי הָרַבָּנִי וְכוּ', מוֹרֵנוּ הָרַב אַבְרָהָם בֶּער שֶׁיִּחְיֶה, וּבִשְׁלוֹם יְדִידִי הָרַבָּנִי וְכוּ' מוֹרֵנוּ הָרַב אַבֶּילֶי שֶׁיִּחְיֶה, עִם כָּל בְּנֵי בֵיתוֹ וְיוֹצְאֵי חֲלָצָיו שֶׁיִּחְיוּ, וּבִשְׁלוֹם כָּל אַנְשֵׁי שְׁלוֹמֵנוּ בְּאַהֲבָה רַבָּה. כְּבָר הוֹדִיעוּ לָהֶם שֶׁאֲנִי כָּעֵת פֹּה קְהִלַּת אוּמַאן, וּבָאתִי לְפֹה בְּיוֹם ג' תּוֹלְדוֹת הֶעָבַר, וּכְפִי הַנִּרְאֶה אֶתְעַכֵּב פֹּה עוֹד אֵיזֶה יָמִים אוֹ שָׁבוּעוֹת. וְקָרוֹב שֶׁאֶתְעַכֵּב פֹּה אוֹ בִּסְבִיבוֹת אֵלּוּ עַל שַׁבַּת חֲנֻכָּה הַבָּא עָלֵינוּ לְטוֹבָה. וְכָעֵת אֵין מִלָּה בִּלְשׁוֹנִי לְהוֹדִיעָם דָּבָר, כִּי אֲנִי מְצַפֶּה לְקַבֵּל מִכְתָּבָם שֶׁלְּדַעְתִּי כְּבָר נִשְׁלְחוּ לְטוּלְטְשִׁין לַהֲשִׁיבֵנִי עַל כָּל מַה שֶּׁבִּקַּשְׁתִּי. וּכְבָר כָּתַב יְדִידִי רַבִּי אַבְרָהָם בֶּער שֶׁיִּחְיֶה בָּאִגֶּרֶת לְאִמּוֹ זֶה כְּמוֹ שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁבוּעוֹת שֶׁבְּסָמוּךְ יְשִׁיבֵנִי כָּרָאוּי. עַל כֵּן אֵין כָּעֵת לְהַאֲרִיךְ, וּבִקַּשְׁתִּי בְּאִם עֲדַיִן לֹא נִשְׁלַח מֵאִתָּם לְטוּלְטְשִׁין כַּנַּ"ל, שֶׁיְמַהֲרוּ לִשְׁלֹחַ לְטוּלְטְשִׁין כַּנַּ"ל. וּתְהִלָּה לָאֵל כְּבָר שָׁלַחְתִּי אֶת רַבִּי נַחְמָן מִטּוּלְטְשִׁין בְּהָעֵסֶק שֶׁלָּנוּ. וַה' יַצְלִיחַ דַּרְכּוֹ, וַעֲדַיִן אֵין לִי שׁוּם יְדִיעָה מִמֶּנּוּ, כִּי זֶה סָמוּךְ שֶׁיָּצָא מִבְּרֶסְלֶב בְּיוֹם א' חַיֵּי שָׂרָה. ה' יִגְמֹר בַּעֲדֵנוּ לִגְמֹר חֶפְצֵנוּ הַקְּדוֹשִׁים כָּרָאוּי. וַאֲנַחְנוּ לֹא נֵדַע מַה נַּעֲשֶׂה וְכוּ'.

And to all our anshei sh'lomaynu with great love.

segments.he: דִּבְרֵי אוֹהַבָם בֶּאֱמֶת הָאוֹחֵז בְּחַבְלֵי עֲבוֹתוֹת אַהֲבַתְכֶם וּמַעְתִּיר בַּעַדְכֶם.
segments.en: They have already been informed that he is now here — in the congregation of Uman. And he arrived here on the past Tuesday — Parshas Toldos. And apparently he will remain here still some days or weeks. And it is likely that he will remain here or in these surroundings for Shabbas Chanukah coming upon them for good. And just now he has no word in his tongue to inform them of anything — for he is waiting to receive their letter — which in his view was already sent to Tultchin to reply to him on all that he requested. And already his dear friend Rabbi Avraham Ber — may he live — wrote in a letter to his mother — some three weeks ago — that shortly he would reply to him properly. Therefore there is no need just now to extend. And he requested — if the letter has not yet been sent from them to Tultchin as above — that they hasten to send to Tultchin as above. And praised be G-d — he already sent Rabbi Nachman of Tultchin in their work. And may Hashem make his way successful. And still he has no information from him — for he only just now left Breslov — on Sunday of Parshas Chayei Sara. May Hashem complete for them — to complete their holy desires as befitting — and we do not know what to do — and so forth.

segments.en: The words of one who loves them in truth — who holds fast in the bonds and cords of your love — and intercedes for you.

segments.he: וּכְבָר הוֹדַעְתִּים שֶׁבְּאִם ִיסְעוּ לְפֹה, יִסְעוּ דֶּרֶךְ טִירָהאוִויצֶע, כִּי יָכוֹל לִהְיוֹת שֶׁיִּמְצְאוּ אוֹתִי שָׁם. וְאָנֹכִי אֵינִי יוֹדֵעַ עַתָּה כְּלָל אֵיךְ יִתְנַהֵג הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ עִמִּי. וַאֲנִי מַשְׁלִיךְ עַצְמִי עָלָיו יִתְבָּרַךְ וְעַל זְכוּתוֹ שֶׁל רַבֵּנוּ הַנּוֹרָא זֵכֶר צַדִּיק וְקָדוֹשׁ לִבְרָכָה. נַפְשִׁי יְשׁוֹבֵב יַנְחֵנִי בְמַעְגְּלֵי צֶדֶק לְמַעַן שְׁמוֹ.
segments.en: Nussun of Breslov. Overview: Tuesday, Parshas Vayeitzei — Uman — 5602. To Rabbi Avraham Ber and Rabbi Abeli and all the anshei sh'lomaynu. They have already been informed that he is now here in the congregation of Uman. He arrived here on the past Tuesday — Parshas Toldos. And apparently he will remain still some days or weeks — and it is likely he will be here or in these surroundings for Shabbas Chanukah. Just now he has no word to inform them of anything — for he is waiting to receive their letter — which in his view was already sent to Tultchin to reply to him on all that he requested. And already Rabbi Avraham Ber wrote in a letter to his mother — some three weeks ago — that shortly he would reply properly. He requested — if the letter has not yet been sent — that they hasten to send to Tultchin. And praised be G-d — he already sent Rabbi Nachman of Tultchin in their work. And may Hashem make his way successful. Still he has no information from him — for he only just now left Breslov on Sunday of Parshas Chayei Sara. May Hashem complete for them — to complete their holy desires as befitting — and we do not know what to do. And he has already informed them — that if they travel here — they should travel via Tirahowitz. And he does not know just now how Hashem Yisborach will conduct Himself with him. And he throws himself upon Him Yisborach — and upon the merit of the Rebbe. Nafshi y'shoveiv yancheni b'magelei tzedek l'ma'an sh'mo.
